## Type of change

- [ ] Factual correction
- [ ] Documentation or prose
- [ ] Accessibility fix
- [ ] Content policy change
- [ ] Data in `data/`
- [ ] Social card or asset
- [ ] The checks in `tools/`
- [ ] Something else

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and this change meets the standard it describes.
- [ ] I ran the checks locally and they pass.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes — data and prose agree, and no page is out of date.
- [ ] If I changed a count, a name, a URL or a definition, I updated **every** place that states it, not just this one.
- [ ] No internal path, stack name, version or credential appears anywhere in the change.
- [ ] Nothing published claims affiliation, endorsement or approval that does not exist.
- [ ] Any new or changed page has a title and description within the documented lengths.
- [ ] The page reads completely with JavaScript disabled.
- [ ] I tabbed through anything interactive and the focus order makes sense.
- [ ] Everything is verifiable. I have not written anything I could not confirm.
